claims.text: Untreated, illness lasts a few days to a month or longer and may follow a remitting-relapsing course

claims.text: Common symptoms: watery diarrhea, loss of appetite, weight loss, abdominal cramping and bloating, increased gas, nausea, prolonged fatigue; less common: vomiting, body aches, headaches, low-grade fever

claims.text: CDC advises clinicians to consider Cyclospora as a potential cause of prolonged diarrheal illness
claims.quote: Consider Cyclospora as a potential cause of prolonged diarrheal illness

claims.text: Clinicians should specifically request Cyclospora testing when indicated; it is missed unless requested
claims.quote: Testing for Cyclospora is not routinely conducted in most U.S. laboratories, even when stool is tested for parasites. Healthcare providers should specifically request testing for Cyclospora if indicated.

claims.text: Spreads through food or water contaminated with human feces
claims.quote: Cyclospora spreads when people eat food or drink water that is contaminated with human poop (feces or stool).

claims.text: Direct person-to-person spread is unlikely
claims.quote: This means that spread directly from person to person is unlikely.

claims.text: Takes around 1 to 2 weeks outside the body to become infectious
claims.quote: It takes Cyclospora around 1 to 2 weeks after passing in a bowel movement and outside the body to become infectious.

claims.text: Incubation usually about one week, range 2 days to 2 weeks or more
claims.quote: The time between becoming infected and becoming sick is usually about one week but can range from 2 days to 2 weeks or more.

claims.text: Infects the small intestine and causes watery, sometimes frequent diarrhea
claims.quote: The Cyclospora parasite infects the small intestine and can cause watery and sometimes frequent diarrhea.

claims.text: Children, people with weakened immune systems, and older people may have more severe illness or complications from severe dehydration
claims.quote: Children, people with weakened immune systems, and older people may experience more severe illness or complications from severe dehydration.

claims.text: Rest and drink plenty of fluids with diarrhea
claims.quote: It's important that you rest and drink plenty of fluids if you have diarrhea.

claims.text: TMP-SMX (Bactrim, Septra, Cotrim) is the treatment of choice
claims.quote: Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (TMP-SMX) is the treatment of choice for cyclosporiasis. ... sold as Bactrim, Septra, or Cotrim

claims.text: Adult regimen: TMP 160 mg + SMX 800 mg (one DS tablet) orally twice daily for 7-10 days
claims.quote: TMP 160 mg plus SMX 800 mg (one double strength tablet), orally, twice a day, for 7–10 days.

claims.text: Patients with weakened immune systems may need longer courses
claims.quote: Patients with weakened immune systems may need longer courses of therapy.

claims.text: No highly effective alternative for TMP-SMX allergy or intolerance
claims.quote: No highly effective alternatives have been identified for patients who are allergic to (or are intolerant of) TMP-SMX.

claims.text: Approaches: observation and symptomatic treatment, or nitazoxanide and ciprofloxacin if TMP-SMX not feasible; effectiveness uncertain
claims.quote: Observation and symptomatic treatment ... Use of nitazoxanide and ciprofloxacin—if treatment with TMP-SMX is not feasible ... Effectiveness of either alternative drug is uncertain

claims.text: Desensitization only for selected patients who require treatment, evaluated by an allergist, without life-threatening allergy
claims.quote: This approach should be considered only for selected patients who require treatment, have been evaluated by an allergist, and do not have a life-threatening allergy

claims.text: Most patients with healthy immune systems recover without treatment
claims.quote: Most patients who have healthy immune systems will recover without treatment.
